method: Join official injury-report designations (nflverse mirror; spot-checked rows VERIFIED) with the current official club depth charts (nflverse mirror). A player counts as a 'starter deficiency' only when the depth chart lists them at rank 1 for their position slot.

rows.backup_next_man: UNVERIFIED — player shows no depth rank-1 evidence this season (backup, not a starter deficiency) or depth-chart match failed
rows.verification: VERIFIED (injury row official; join is MODEL)
rows.join_note: Backup name is a MODEL JOIN of the official injury report and the official club depth chart (nflverse mirror of both) — not an announced lineup.
